Date May 22,2026



To whom it may Concern,

Once again I am not a lawyer and should not need to hire one to defend my homestead. I would
like the following added to my testimony because reading 1000+ pages of documents filed by
Oncor and LCRA is not feasible in the timeline allotted while working full-time and fulfilling my
other commitments.

June 16-18, 2025 3 meetings were held in Salado, Lampasas and Menard. Why? For LCRA
and Oncor to gather feedback from landowners. Property owners within 500' of the centerline of
a tower were invited. WHY DOES THIS MATTER? I was not invited and neither were my
neighbors, some elderly. We were not added as a proposed route until March 2026 when
Appendix B was created and filed.

I received my packet March 31, 2026 (I believe it was in my mailbox on the 30th) and certain big
farms connected to representatives and other political parties in Bell County had since LAST
JUNE to form coalitions, hire lawyers and prepare to fight this battle. We are defending our
homesteads - where we live. Parties in Bell county filed on the docket prior to landowners ever
receiving their first ever notice about the project! Talk about being behind the 8 ball from the
start.

Every change made to the line in March 2026 needs to be voided and removed from the
process all together. The people on the route need time for their due process, time to hire
representation if needed, notify the public, etc.

If this was your home, would you be ok with this process? Ok with political representatives
pushing a project out of their community and blindsiding a community that has not been properly
warned? Take note and pay attention if you allow this to happen - you could be next.
